Did not run any browser or GPU-pod command anywhere in this tool or its self-test — offline only. All evidence commands in roadmap.json are cheap Node checks, each timed under 2s.

headline: Built the MECHANISM per the coordinator's redirect, not a permanent transcription: orchestration/roadmap.json (flat `items` list, each carrying `id`/`phase`/`title`/`visible_outcome`/`state`/`closes_when`/`evidence`/`blocked_by`, schema-general — no hard-coded step count anywhere in the tool) and tools/roadmap.mjs, which verifies every done/in_progress claim's evidence at run time (path / command / json_field checks), reports UNVERIFIED loudly and excludes it from progress, counts `unevidenced` items separately (33/40 right now, honestly, because Phase B-F is deliberately unplanned), computes a full-roadmap percentage plus a clearly-labelled Phase A sub-total, drift-checks against ROADMAP.md's prose (non-fatal while `provisional`), and writes docs/data/roadmap.json for the published page (tools/roadmap-report.mjs, wired into tools/progress.mjs and tools/publish.mjs, same pattern as tools/cost-report.mjs). Self-test: 25/25 arms pass, including the required 'both arms genuinely disagree' pairs for: evidence present vs removed, not_started vs done-claim-with-no-evidence, command evidence true vs false, json_field evidence right vs wrong state, a 2-item fixture's progress with vs without its evidence, drift detected vs clean (both the Phase-A-heading form and the Phase-B-F-bullet form), and drift fatal vs non-fatal under `provisional`. Live break-test against the REAL (non-fixture) roadmap.json also performed and reversed (see log below) — the instrument goes red on real data, not just on its own fixture.
live_break_test_against_real_data: Rule 4. Corrupted orchestration/roadmap.json's step-1a evidence path to a nonexistent file, ran `node tools/roadmap.mjs`: step-1a correctly flipped to [UNVERIFIED] with the exact missing-path reason printed, and the overall count dropped from 1/40 to 0/40. Restored the file from a backup, re-ran: back to 1/40 with step-1a [DONE]. Not a simulation — this ran against the committed roadmap.json and tools/roadmap.mjs together.
